summary: Azure Resource Manager credentials (subscription ID, username/password or client ID/secret, tenant ID, cloud environment) sync Azure inventory; service principals map to AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_SECRET, AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID, AZURE_TENANT and AZURE_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT, AD users to AZURE_AD_USER and AZURE_PASSWORD.
